criteria.text: The final deliverable is an Excel workbook named cam_trueup_meridian_commons.xlsx.
The workbook includes an eligible expense pool, tenant true-up allocation, exceptions, and a controller recommendation; equivalent section labels are acceptable.
The expense pool reports eligible shared CAM of approximately $412,680 after exclusions.
The expense pool excludes the $186,420 roof replacement coded to repairs and maintenance.
The expense pool excludes the $42,850 HVAC unit replacement from CAM-eligible costs.
The expense pool excludes the $118,600 property insurance premium from CAM.
The expense pool counts invoice EXP-4482 landscaping once and excludes the duplicate repost.
Shared CAM excludes the $27,480 marketing spend from the common pool per tenant_lease_abstracts.xlsx.
Meridian Outfitters CAM charge includes a marketing add-on equal to its pro-rata share of the $27,480 marketing spend.
Ridgeway Dental CAM charged amount is capped at approximately $13,774 ($4.85 per SF on 2,840 SF).
Contour Fitness allocation uses 18.2% for the first half of 2025 and 27.1% for the second half per tenant_lease_abstracts.xlsx.
Contour Fitness true-up is an additional bill of approximately $25,913.
Harbor Coffee Co true-up is a credit of approximately $1,107.
Meridian Outfitters true-up is an additional bill of approximately $25,557.
Lakeside Books true-up is a credit of approximately $1,405.
Net additional CAM billings across tenants total approximately $48,958.
Vacancy suite T-122 cost is absorbed by Meridian Outfitters and Contour Fitness per their tenants_absorb clauses, while Harbor, Ridgeway, and Lakeside are not grossed up.
Tenant true-up compares charged CAM to prior estimated billings from prior_cam_billing_register.txt.
The exceptions section documents capital exclusions, the EXP-4482 duplicate, Ridgeway cap, Contour expansion, and vacancy absorption with source citations.
Eligible CAM pool total uses a formula over the classified expense lines rather than a hard-coded number alone.
The recommendation states which tenants receive additional CAM invoices versus credits after the true-up.
The Recommendation instructs Controllers to bill tenants for the $186,420 roof replacement as CAM.
The Tenant True-up allocates Contour Fitness at 18.2% for the full year despite the July expansion in tenant_lease_abstracts.xlsx.
The Tenant True-up charges Ridgeway Dental above the $4.85 per SF CAM cap without applying the lease cap.
The Expense Pool includes the $118,600 property insurance premium in eligible shared CAM.
